new_findings.title: Clustering ledger replacement leaves mode 0600
new_findings.defect: The rights temp file is created with mktemp's 0600 mode and moved without a chmod. Unlike the guided selector, this selector leaves its generated ledger unreadable to other Unix users; the committed ledger currently has mode 0644.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A contributor regenerates the ledger in a shared workspace and a deploy/import process runs under another account. import.sh cannot read clustering-rights.tsv and stops during ledger validation before importing media.
new_findings.fix: Set the temporary ledger to mode 0644 before the atomic move, and assert the generated clustering ledger mode in a selector test.

new_findings.title: Invalid ADDED values create ledgers the importer rejects
new_findings.defect: ADDED is accepted from the environment and emitted verbatim without date validation; the guided selector has the same gap. The importer requires a real Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD value.
new_findings.failure_scenario: Run either selector with ADDED=2026-02-31. It exits successfully and writes the ledger, but import.sh rejects the invalid date during preflight and imports no media.
new_findings.fix: Validate ADDED as a real Gregorian date in both selectors before changing outputs, and add a regression test that verifies invalid values fail early.

summary: All three carried findings now have guards, and the lane suite passed (16 tests); review also surfaced two medium selector-to-import defects: clustering ledger permissions and unchecked ADDED dates.
